what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at the Bilotta Meeting Room, Town Hall; also on Zoom (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=82935305945, Meeting ID 909 174 0347, phone (888) 475-4499) as a courtesy, and broadcast on Lunenburg Public Access, Facebook Live and YouTube. The meeting will not pause if the virtual broadcast fails.

items.agenda_line: Update on Food Pantry Relocation and License Agreement
items.why_it_matters: The Board may discuss the food pantry's move and the license agreement that would govern its use of space.
A policy on a special education reserve fund is listed under new business, touching how school-related reserve money may be handled.
The Board is listed to give its recommendations on the articles for the November 17 Special Town Meeting; the sub-item prints no article details.

items.agenda_line: Introduce Draft of Flag Policy with Modifications
items.why_it_matters: A modified draft of a flag policy is to be introduced to the Board.
The Board may discuss the town's municipal buildings, with no specifics printed on the agenda.

items.agenda_line: Ratification of the Town Manager’s Appointment of Alexander McLean as Videographer, effective October 28, 2026
items.why_it_matters: The Board is asked to ratify a town staff hiring for the videographer position, effective the day after the meeting.

items.agenda_line: Change of Officers/Directors Application for Existing Liquor License for Global Montello Group Corporation
items.why_it_matters: A public hearing on a change of officers or directors for an existing liquor license at Honey Farms, 134 Leominster-Shirley Road.
